facts.onRemap: delete PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL rows of the content reference

title: The configurator deletes a content reference's PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL tombstones when it maps it again
statement: When the Page and Field Configurator maps a content reference whose service configuration was removed earlier, PIA deletes that content reference's PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL rows; the PSPTCSSRVCNFDEL tombstones of its services stay. The classic Event Mapping page does not (it kept the tombstone when re-adding a configuration, capture em08).

observations.observation: After two Remove Mapping runs had left two PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL rows on the content reference, Apply Configuration deleted both and kept the service tombstones (RCSCM +1, SCNFM +4, SYS +5).

Saving the lab Standard configuration inactive removed both content references' service configurations (one PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL each, RCSCM +2, SCNFM +8, SYS +10); saving it active again re-created them and deleted both PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL rows, keeping the 26 service tombstones on each.
